items.name: Open Sandwich Club
items.description: A platter take on the classic sandwich—4 crispy boneless chicken, Texas toast, plus your choice of one sauce (Galbi Mayo or Hot Mayo) and one side (Coleslaw, Fried Pickles, or Fries)

items.name: Golden Original Sandwich
items.description: Meet our signature Golden Original in a mouth-watering chicken sandwich. Crisp Golden Original chicken on top of a rich brioche bun with a spread of spicy mayo. (2oz Secret Sauce & 4oz Coleslaw)

items.name: Spicy Original Sandwich
items.description: Spice up your day with our Spicy Original Sandwich. Crisp Spicy Original chicken on top of a rich brioche bun with a spread of spicy mayo. (2oz Hot Spicy Sauce & 4oz Coleslaw)

items.name: Chicken Fried Rice
items.description: Stir-fried rice with chicken and veggies topped with a sunny-side-up egg and garnished with spring onion and sesame seeds.

items.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
items.description: Rice, chicken, and vegetables stir fired in a spicy red-pepper base and topped with a fried egg.

items.name: Caribbean Spice Rice Bowl
items.description: A tropical take on our signature rice bowl. Filled with crispy, boneless fried chicken, slathered in our own Caribbean Jerk sauce, topped with fried eggs, and finished with a swirl of mayo.

items.name: Kimchicken Rice Bowl
items.description: This flavorful Korean Rice bowl is topped in stir fried-kimchi and spicy boneless chicken, for a truly explosive taste.

items.name: Bulgogi Rice Bowl
items.description: White rice covered with thinly sliced ribeye, marinated in bulgogi sauce. Served with yellow daikon and green onions.

items.name: Ddeok-Bokki
items.description: This classic Korean street food is made from a combination of rice cakes and fish cakes cooked in a sweet and spicy red chili reduction. Served with fresh cabbage and chopped scallions, garnished with a fried egg and sesame seeds, it’s a warm and chewy comfort.

items.name: Rose Ddeok-Bokki
items.description: The same rice and fish cakes we use in traditional Ddeok-Bokki, but cooked in a less spicy, more creamy rose sauce. Paired with the cabbage, egg, and sesame seed, it’s a mild masterpiece.

items.name: bb.q Cheese Ball
items.description: A crispy, golden appetizer of cheese-filled balls, warm and melty inside.

items.name: Cheesling Cheese Ball
items.description: A crispy, golden appetizer of cheese-filled balls, warm and melty inside, dusted in a rich medley of sweet cheeses.

items.name: Cheesling Fries
items.description: Crispy, golden french fries dusted in our rich Cheeseling powder.

items.name: Coleslaw
items.description: A sweet and crunchy side of shredded cabbage mixed with a creamy dressing.

items.name: Ito En Oi Ocha Green Tea [Bottle]
Lemon Fizz [Can]
items.description: A refreshing lemon sparkling iced tea made with a pu-erh tea extract base

items.name: Sandwich Combo
items.description: Sandwich + Coleslaw + French Fries + Soda Extra $1.20 for Sweet Potato Fries or Cheese Sticks or Onion Rings

items.name: Sandwich Deluxe Combo
items.description: Sandwich Deluxe + Coleslaw + French Fries + Soda (Extra $1.20 for Sweet Potato Fries, Cheese Sticks, or Onion Rings)
